note: Prose and policy for the generated Examiner Index V2. No number in this file reaches a page: every count is len() of the records the generator writes. Examiner order is presentation order; membership comes from EXAMINER_ALIAS_REGISTER.json (an examiner without a slug is not rendered, an examiner in the data but not in the register is a build failure).

examiner_blurbs.nair: Conventions / MARPOL / PSC — expects verbatim regulation numbers
examiner_blurbs.rajappan: Stability / cargo — GZ curve, IS Code numbers
examiner_blurbs.senthil: Safety / LSA — procedure sequences with SOLAS references
examiner_blurbs.john: MARPOL / SOLAS / PSC / management — questions reported by candidates in an external surveyor compilation

external_only_note: Reported from an external surveyor compilation only. MIW has not yet confirmed these against its own tracker, so every row here carries the Reported badge, never Confirmed.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.meaning: one or more primary tracker records name this examiner and this question

reported.label: Reported
reported.meaning: an external surveyor compilation reports this examiner asking this question; not tracker-confirmed

ce_tip.label: CE Tip
ce_tip.meaning: the QB card itself declares the attribution; not tracker-confirmed

header.label: Header
header.meaning: attribution from the QB page header only

inferred.label: Inferred
inferred.meaning: topic inference; no primary record and no page assertion
